transcript_only_text:
Last week, someone left a plate on one
of my machines. I had put plates back basically every other time that I walked
in the gym for probably like a month. And I was getting a little tired of it.
And so, I was trying to play detective during that like month trying to figure
out who was doing it be like, "Hey man, by the way, just put your weights back."
As I was putting the weights back, I was like,
"This is a complete and utter waste of my time." But, I was like, "How am I
going to figure out a way that I can reward and publicly show that this is
not okay?" I posted a picture of the weights and I said, "Hey, no one's
allowed to work out today because we, as a company, didn't know how to clean up
after ourselves." And then the next day, and this is the key part, when the gym
was clean, I took a picture of the clean gym and I was like, "Great job,
everyone. Way to keep it clean." And then I will also be able to, again
today, like the day before yesterday, I took a picture of the gym when I went in
and it was clean and I said, "Great job." Cuz the worst thing in the world
is you punish people when a plane crashes, but you don't give them
applause when they land it right every other time.
